pack.name: Obsidian Showcase
pack.description: Hyaloclast Vulkan technology showcase featuring multi-bounce SHaRC GI, ReSTIR DI colored lights, mirror-polished LabPBR metals, POM relief, volumetric cumulus, and AgX grading.

low.label: Low
low.description: Lighter showcase profile with foliage wind disabled, reduced fog, and single-bounce path tracing.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Balanced showcase profile with foliage wind, subtle parallax occlusion, and two-bounce GI.

high.label: High
high.description: Default Obsidian Showcase profile with POM relief, volumetric shafts, SHaRC multi-bounce GI, and wet puddles.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: Uncompromised showcase with deep POM relief, high-bounce path tracing, intense god rays, and mirror-wet puddles.
